art_direction: bright observational cinema for a presentation: deliberate framing, natural window light, credible human action and readable environmental negative space; vary shot distance rather than adding ornamental graphics
palette: daylight whites, natural skin tones, soft graphite #292D2C, muted olive #77816A and warm wood; preserve open midtones; time of day follows supplied content
typography: medium-weight Chinese humanist sans serif for clear headlines and direct labels; restrained Song-style title optional when it fits the scene
materials: photorealistic skin pores, cloth weave and worn surfaces, subtle fine grain and gentle highlight rolloff; midtones remain visible and shadow detail is retained

anchors.prompt: one natural architectural edge framing the scene, without an added film border
one localized patch of motivated window or practical light consistent with the time of day
one existing spatial leading line guiding attention toward the action

text_layout: one concise headline or supplied quotation plus essential labels; compose a quiet wall, sky or softly defocused region for text; analytical content has a broad neutral margin
contrast: graphite text on a light environmental field or warm-white text on a genuinely dark field; choose one polarity per text block, keep faces and highlights separate

film-opening.label: 日光场景
film-opening.summary: 用可辨认的空间、时间与人物动作建立开场
film-opening.composition: wide establishing shot with one primary human-scale action and a naturally quiet wall or sky for the headline; protect midtone detail
film-opening.imagery: photorealistic content-relevant location, natural window or outdoor light, visible midtones and a concrete human gesture; maintain a clean environmental text field

title_treatment.weight: calm conclusion with deliberate line breaks

requirements: establish one place and time of day
a generated illustrative scene is not documentary proof of an actual event
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

human-moment.label: 动作特写
human-moment.summary: 用手部、视线或物件接触呈现一个具体动作
human-moment.composition: a medium close-up or detail of one meaningful action, with a softly quiet adjacent text field; gesture and point of contact carry attention
human-moment.imagery: photorealistic hands, cloth and material texture under motivated light; retain natural imperfections and a credible grip, gaze and posture
requirements: face and copy remain in separate visual fields
the action must support the supplied claim
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

film-comparison.label: 同机位对照
film-comparison.summary: 保持镜头条件一致，让内容本身呈现差异
film-comparison.composition: two matched views of comparable action or space, using consistent camera height, lens and scale; a quiet gutter and aligned captions enable comparison
film-comparison.imagery: photorealistic paired scenes with the same exposure and grading unless light is the explicit comparison variable; preserve referenced identity and location
requirements: both frames share the same comparison dimension
do not manufacture improvement through darker before and brighter after grading
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

film-journey.label: 连续动作
film-journey.summary: 用同一空间中的少量连续镜头说明动作顺序
film-journey.composition: a short matched sequence of two or three adjacent frames when multiple actions must be distinguished, or one continuous scene for a genuinely continuous action; captions stay aligned
film-journey.imagery: consistent location, subjects, props, light direction and camera axis across the sequence; use references for identity continuity
requirements: preserve supplied sequence and spatial direction
if supplied stages exceed available readable frames, simplify imagery without dropping stage labels
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
preserve subject identity and location with references when continuity matters; action remains legible without added explanatory microcopy

film-evidence.label: 场景与数据
film-evidence.summary: 摄影提供背景，平面数据保留足够的阅读面积
film-evidence.composition: a quiet photographic crop beside a broad solid neutral data field; on a data page the chart is the primary reading target, with the scene supplying context
film-evidence.imagery: photorealistic context image paired with flat graphite and muted-olive bars or direct values; marks and labels remain entirely on the neutral field
requirements: data takes enough area to remain readable at projection distance
values, units and geometry follow evidence; illustration does not establish causality
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

quiet-ending.label: 余景收束
quiet-ending.summary: 让一个余下的动作或空场与最后一句共同停留
quiet-ending.composition: a wide lingering frame after the main action, with an open environmental surface in the frozen text zone and a small receding subject if relevant
quiet-ending.imagery: the same location and motivated light as preceding scenes; an empty chair, resting hand or departing figure only when supported by the brief
requirements: the final line remains legible without a title banner
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
